title: SOC2 evidence daily scratchpad - 2026-03-04
content:
Quick running notes / todo (working doc)
Date: 2026-03-04
Owner: Arjun Rahman

Morning plan:
- Prioritize SOC2 evidence items for upcoming auditor checkpoint (week of 2026-03-09).
- Sync with Priya about Okta export and access_review artifacts.
- Finish vendor risk review notes for Datadog and Auth0.

Top TODOs (high priority)
[ ] Pull last quarter access_review CSV from Okta (okta-access-reviews-2025-Q4.csv) and drop into evidence bucket. (Priya assigned)
[ ] Confirm MFA enforcement timeline for non-service accounts (JIRA-SEC-152)
[ ] Upload Datadog retention policy PDF and diagram of log flow to Confluence page (Evidence-Inventory).
[ ] Validate that Dedicated deployment network ACL change requests have recorded approvals (ticket SEC-47).

Progress / notes:
- Auth0 vendor review: initial questionnaire done. Outstanding: 3 items on encryption-at-rest documentation. Action: ping vendor rep (case #AUTH-342).
- Datadog: retention settings screenshot captured (datadog-retention-2026-02-20.png). Need confirmation from infra that log forwarding uses TLS and that no PII is stored in plain logs. Noah to verify.
- Okta: Priya pulled partial export yesterday, but missing historical admin activity csv. Logged an ask to Okta support (support ticket OKTA-8891).

Meeting notes: compliance sync 2026-03-04 10:30am with Priya / Noah
- Auditor will ask for sample of recent access reviews and proof of remediation. We should prepare 2 samples (one for hosters, one for internal).
- Asked about service account inventory: engineering needs to tag all service accounts with "service:true" label for automated reporting. Action: create infra RFC (owner: Arjun).
- Rollout of MFA: plan to enforce for 100% of interactive users by 2026-04-15. Document exceptions process.

Evidence artifacts to assemble (quick checklist):
- Okta: access_review CSVs, admin activity logs (last 90 days), SSO config export.
- IAM: dedicated-team role list + last 30 days of role changes (iam-role-changes-2026-02-xx.csv).
- Encryption: KMS key rotation proof (kms-rotation-2025-11.pdf).
- Logging: Datadog retention screenshot + log forwarder TLS config (datadog-logs-tls.txt).
- Network: ACL approval tickets (SEC-47, SEC-49).

Vendor review quick notes:
- Auth0: good for SAML/SSO but need stronger evidence of key rotation and HSM usage for certain customers. Follow-up: request formal crypto report. (due 2026-03-06)
- Datadog: retention policy fine but need written confirmation that agent->forwarder uses TLS and that forwarding endpoints have mTLS in place for log ingest. (Noah assigned)
- Sendgrid (email provider): confirm suppression list handling and whether any customer content stored unencrypted. (low priority)

Questions / open items:
- Do we have a finalized list of "critical" systems that require additional evidence packaging? I think: Okta, Datadog, S3 buckets with customer data, Dedicated infra GPUs (for Private customers)
- Which repo stores the service account tagging script? Note to self: check infra/tools/service-account-tagging.

Short commands / refs:
- Okta export path: Admin -> Reports -> System Log -> Export CSV (filter: 2026-01-01..2026-03-04)
- Datadog retention: Settings -> Logs -> Indexes

Next actions (today):
- 11:00am: quick async with Priya to confirm which Okta exports are missing. (15m)
- 1:30pm: review Datadog screenshots and confirm with Noah. (30m)
- 3:00pm: draft Confluence evidence upload structure and share with team for review. (45m)

Attachments / files I will upload to evidence bucket:
- okta-access-reviews-2025-Q4.csv
- datadog-retention-2026-02-20.png
- kms-rotation-2025-11.pdf
- iam-role-changes-2026-02.csv

Notes to self:
- Keep this doc light — use Confluence for finalized evidence with stable links. This file is for quick capture only.
- If auditors request anything not in Evidence-Inventory, escalate to Priya and tag in Slack #security-audit.

End of scratchpad.
